art_direction: Wu Xie alone stands quietly just inside the familiar rented room, lit by cool overcast window light. He looks at the same white blue-rimmed bowl of now-long-untouched noodles and the chopsticks on the old wooden table. Convey elapsed time through a thin layer of dust and slightly faded food, no close-up of mold, no grotesque decay. The pale enamel kettle and unoccupied stool remain in their places. His posture is still, grief restrained; do not show Pan Zi or another person.
visible_description: 吴邪独自走入潘子的出租屋，望见放久的面。
poster_text: 很久以后，吴邪回来，看见那碗面已坏了。
source_chapter: 《盗墓笔记8》大结局第七十四章（二）
adaptation_note: 小三爷到门口叫人、出发前回望和离开路上的画面为基于用户叙述的虚构改编；潘子是否预感归期为吴邪的猜测。
